title: Machine Learning: Vertex AI Architecture — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Real-Time Online Inference Flow: client mobile app request -> API Gateway -> Vertex AI Prediction Endpoint -> Feature Store online lookup -> inference return.
routing_rationale: Online feature lookup decouples the mobile client from feature computation: client sends user ID, and Vertex AI enriches the payload with 50 engineered features in 3 milliseconds.

nodes.label: Checkout: $340 Cart
nodes.detail: User attempts transaction; app requests real-time fraud risk score.

nodes.label: Vertex Prediction Worker
nodes.detail: Runs scoring algorithm in 2.2ms on dedicated container runtime.

nodes.label: Fraud Score: 0.02 (Approved)
nodes.detail: Returns transaction approval token to mobile app in 14ms.

steps.title: Online Feature Enrichment
steps.action: Prediction worker retrieves customer features from Feature Store in 3ms.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates need for mobile client to compute or pass complex feature histories.

steps.title: Low-Latency Fraud Scoring
steps.action: Model evaluates 50 features and outputs fraud probability of 0.02 in 2.2ms.
steps.why_traversal: Secures financial transaction without adding perceptible friction to checkout.

scenarios.label: Batch Feature Sync Lag Causes False Rejections
scenarios.root_cause: Hourly streaming ingestion to Feature Store failed, causing customer spend features to be stale.
scenarios.recovery: Transition to real-time streaming feature ingestion using Vertex AI Feature Store streaming write API.
